name: marblo-functions
description: Marblo Cloud Functions (TossPayments KR + Paddle global integration)

scripts.test:reject: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderReject.test.mjs'
scripts.test:followup: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderFollowup.test.mjs'
scripts.test:survey-offer: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderSurveyOffer.test.mjs'
scripts.test:consent-sync: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/marketingConsentSync.test.mjs'
scripts.test:marketing: tsc src/marketingContacts.ts src/marketingContacts.test.ts --outDir .test-out/marketing --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict && node --test .test-out/marketing/marketingContacts.test.js
scripts.test:admin-analytics: tsc src/adminAnalytics.ts src/adminAnalytics.test.ts --outDir .test-out/admin --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict && node --test .test-out/admin/adminAnalytics.test.js
